record.synthesis_method: in-situ cation metathesis (TBAF to LiF) for composites; PIM-1 coated on Celgard 2325 as control
record.evidence_quote: interestingly, σ20C is only 2.2 µS cm–1 for PIM-1
record.notes: PIM-1 is the positive-control polymer (PIM-1 on Celgard 2325) with liquid electrolyte (1.0 M LiPF6 in EC:DMC) present; it is a gel-type control rather than a true solid conductor. EIS method is from the Table 1 footnote. Values for LESA-1 to LESA-6 (0.29 to 3.30 x10-5 S cm-1) are in a multi-line table row and were not recorded because a verbatim single-line quote could not be assured.
